Priyanka Desai
Data Scientist focused on applied ML and analytics | Hyderabad
priyanka.desai317@example.com | +91 9603038066 | Immediate joiner

Summary
Applied data scientist with a track record of delivering production ML models and analytics-driven product improvements. Strong focus on end-to-end model development, SQL-driven feature engineering and reproducible pipelines. Comfortable collaborating with product and engineering teams to translate business requirements into measurable outcomes.

Experience

Pixelwave Studios — Apr 2024 - Mar 2026
Data Scientist (Hybrid)
- Designed and implemented recommendation and content-ranking experiments using SQL and Python3 to personalize user feeds, improving click-through rate by 18% and increasing average session duration by 12%.
- Built ETL pipelines to aggregate behavioral and content metadata from multiple sources using SQL, reducing data prep time for modeling by 40%.
- Developed A/B test analysis frameworks in Python3 and scikit-learn-compatible preprocessing, enabling rapid iteration and reliable significance reporting for product launches.
- Maintained model monitoring dashboards and automated retraining triggers; used Git for version control and Confluence for documentation to ensure reproducibility.

Meesho — Mar 2023 - Mar 2024
Machine Learning Engineer (On-site)
- Implemented production scoring pipelines in Python3 and PyTorch to power a personalized search relevance model, improving conversion rate for targeted cohorts by 9%.
- Led end-to-end model lifecycle: feature engineering via SQL, model training with scikit-learn and PyTorch, and deployment-ready serialization; optimized inference latency by 25%.
- Collaborated with SRE and backend teams to containerize models and set up CI/CD with Git; documented model contracts and runbooks in Confluence.
- Performed offline evaluation and calibration, improving model precision at top-k by 14% while maintaining recall thresholds.

Tata Consultancy Services — Apr 2021 - Feb 2023
Data Scientist (Remote)
- Developed deep learning architectures in PyTorch and Python3 for computer vision and NLP PoCs; achieved a 16% improvement in validation metrics over baseline models.
- Conducted large-scale feature extraction and joins using SQL to create training datasets from enterprise systems, reducing label leakage and improving generalization.
- Built automated training pipelines and experiments tracking with Git-backed codebases; wrote technical design and postmortem documents in Confluence.
- Collaborated with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business KPIs into ML objectives and presented model performance and ROI estimates to leadership.

Projects
- Personalized Content Ranking: End-to-end project using SQL for feature stores and Python3 for modeling; deployed lightweight PyTorch ranker for production inference with 20% faster response times compared to prior baseline.
- Model Drift Alerting: Implemented a statistical drift detector and automated retraining workflow using scikit-learn and SQL-aggregated metrics; reduced manual intervention by 60%.

Skills
Languages: Python3
Machine Learning: Machine Learning, scikit-learn, Deep Learning, PyTorch
Data & Tools: SQL, Git, Confluence

Education
